anatomyReview.notes: Whole right-facing gull only, slate gray mantle/black white-tipped primaries, white head/body, pale iris/red eye ring, stout yellow bill with red lower-mandible spot and yellow legs. One head/bill, two folded wings far side occluded, two webbed feet. Original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; independent expert and native review pending.

Calling on limestone rock, one head/open bill, two folded wings far side occluded, two webbed feet. Crown and bill inside frame with narrow uncut top/right margins. Low rock fades transparent, no upper-cut prop. Original and ivory alpha-composite individually inspected; independent expert and native review pending.
